text.offer: Yes, I have need of a messenger. It would seem we have a new power in the land, or rather a very old power, full of darkness. Perhaps those fools in the temples will finally get what they deserve for their arrogance. How could they possibly think that their gods are the only gods? Hopefully this letter will help speed the inevitable along. Take it to Priestess Xiana at the Temple of Shal'ille and return to me for your... reward.
text.complete: I suppose you have returned to collect your reward. In truth, your reward is the knowledge of the message you delivered, but... I understand your people's desire for payment of a more material sort, so here it is.

steps.brief: You have been the tool of an unsound person. I expect this from him, but there is no excuse for your depravity. Can you not find a better sponsor for your enthusiasm? Well, perhaps not.
